children: Q3 2026 net revenue rose 6% to SEK 453M (SEK 427M), or 4% in local currencies; adjusted EBIT was SEK 12M (SEK 11M). Pierce expects a temporary negative revenue impact in Q1 2027 from platform migrations.
Growth accelerated in reported terms, though local-currency growth was 4%; no consensus comparison was provided.
Profit improved only slightly year over year, while higher freight and overhead costs pressured margins.
Q1 2027 revenue expected to face temporary pressure
The six largest markets are due to migrate after November; prior migrations lowered sales for three to four months.
Q3 cash SEK 257M, down SEK 62M from Q2
The company attributed the decrease mainly to inventory investment; inventory was SEK 587M versus SEK 490M a year earlier.
The company reported improvement from SEK -69M in FY 2023, indicating a stronger earnings base; periods are not directly comparable.

This report follows a multi-year transformation launched in Q3 2023, with platform migration nearing completion and profitability improved from FY 2023. The next catalyst is execution of the six largest market migrations and the resulting Q1 2027 revenue impact.
